dish: Hand-cut knife-shaved noodles or cat's-ear noodles (Shanxi style)
w: Gao Hong's Shanxi kitchen (since 2014) — the Madison area's go-to for housemade knife-cut and cat's-ear noodles; reviewed by Isthmus, Madison Magazine (twice) and the Cap Times, and profiled by PBS Wisconsin's Wisconsin Life.

dish: Lamb biryani, karhi pakora, lobster korma
w: Middleton's Indian bistro — Best of Madison South Asian winner; Isthmus calls it a menu that 'doesn't even need a buffet', and the Cap Times put its biryani in a Madison Indian showdown.

dish: Layer cakes (lemon sunshine, fudgy raspberry) and breakfast sandwiches
address: 2935 S Fish Hatchery Rd, Fitchburg, WI 53711
w: Fitchburg strip-mall bakery-café that Isthmus rates 'a top-notch breakfast spot and an inventive sandwich shop' as well as a stand-up bakery; on the Cap Times' 22 best strip-mall restaurants.

dish: Panang chicken curry from seven house Thai & Indian curry sauces
w: The original Fitchburg curry counter (now with a University Ave sibling): curries built on seven Thai and Indian sauces; Isthmus-reviewed and on the Cap Times' best strip-mall list.

dish: Beef pho and fresh spring rolls
w: Ann and Henry Tran's west-side pho house (since 2004) — profiled by the Cap Times, Madison Magazine and Isthmus, and on the Cap Times' best strip-mall restaurants list.

dish: Halal shawarma, then baklava or Turkish delight
w: Jordanian chef Mohammed Elbeik's halal bakery-restaurant on Odana (2021): shawarma from meat butchered in-house; reviewed by Isthmus ('a lovely Middle Eastern interlude'), Madison Magazine and the Cap Times.

dish: Cemita de milanesa (Tlaxcala-style sandwich with papalo) and pan dulce
w: Loncheria y panaderia from Tlaxcala natives — huge cemita sandwiches ('aguacate, mas aguacate') and Mexican sweet breads; reviewed by Isthmus and the Cap Times, on the Cap Times' strip-mall best list.

dish: Handmade pasta with Amalfi-coast seafood; brick-oven pizza; limoncello cocktails
w: Bar Corallini alumni Giovanni Novella and Evan Ackers' Neapolitan/Amalfi osteria (Nov 2025) — everything handmade, pasta to mozzarella; covered by the Cap Times and Madison Magazine and named on City Cast's best new bars & restaurants.

dish: Traditional Cornish pasty (steak, potato, onion) — the Mineral Point miners' lunch
w: Pasty counter at the top of State Street since 1976, carrying on the Cornish-miner pasty of SW Wisconsin's lead region; Madison Magazine calls it a Madison staple, and it anchors State Trunk Tour's Wisconsin pasty-shop guide.

dish: The Big Ten burger and a pitcher before a Badgers game
w: The 'KK', the Meier family's campus bar since 1953 (moved to Lake & Langdon in 1972) — the game-day home of Badger athletes and fans, per Wisconsin Alumni Association history and OnMilwaukee's Madison sports-bar guide.

dish: Lunch from the top-ranked carts — Surco Peruvian's lomo saltado or ají de gallina
address: Library Mall (State St at Park St), UW–Madison campus, Madison, WI 53706
w: Madison's famous lunchtime food-cart row between Memorial Library and State Street — spots are awarded by the city's annual cart ranking (2025-26 top scorers: Surco Peruvian, Surco 2, Braisin' Hussies); a campus institution per Isthmus and the Wisconsin Alumni Association.
